21: /**
22:  * Validates a user's first or last name.
23:  *
24:  * @param label The field name to display in error messages (e.g. "First name").

37: /**
38:  * Validates that the given email string is non-empty and follows a valid email address format.
39:  *
40:  * The validation performs two checks:
41:  * 1. The string must not be blank.
42:  * 2. The string must match a simplified email pattern (`local-part@domain`).
43:  *
44:  * The pattern used is:
45:  * ```
46:  * ^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+$
47:  * ```
48:  *
49:  * This covers most common email formats but is not a strict RFC 5322 validator.
50:  *
51:  * @param s The email address to validate.
52:  * @return A descriptive error message if invalid, or `null` if the email is valid.
53:  *
54:  * Example:
55:  * ```
56:  * validateEmail("")                     // → "Email cannot be empty"
57:  * validateEmail("abc@")                 // → "Invalid email format"
58:  * validateEmail("user@example.com")     // → null
59:  * ```
60:  */
61: private val emailRegex = "^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+$".toRegex()

100: /**
101:  * Validates a date triple (day, month, year) for logical consistency and age constraint.
102:  * - Checks numeric format and valid ranges.
103:  * - Verifies that the date exists.
104:  * - Enforces minimum age of 13 years.
105:  *
106:  * @return Triple of day, month, and year error messages (null for valid).
107:  */
108: fun validateDateTriple(
109:     day: String,
110:     month: String,
111:     year: String
112: ): Triple<String?, String?, String?> {
113:   val dayErr =
114:       when {
115:         day.isBlank() -> "Day cannot be empty"
116:         day.toIntOrNull() == null || day.toInt() !in 1..31 -> "Invalid day"
117:         else -> null
118:       }
119:   val monthErr =
120:       when {
121:         month.isBlank() -> "Month cannot be empty"
122:         month.toIntOrNull() == null || month.toInt() !in 1..12 -> "Invalid month"
123:         else -> null
124:       }
125:   val yearErr =
126:       when {
127:         year.isBlank() -> "Year cannot be empty"
128:         year.toIntOrNull() == null || year.toInt() !in 1900..LocalDate.now().year -> "Invalid year"
129:         else -> null
130:       }
131:   if (dayErr != null || monthErr != null || yearErr != null) {
132:     return Triple(dayErr, monthErr, yearErr)
133:   }
134:   try {
135:     val dob = LocalDate.of(year.toInt(), month.toInt(), day.toInt())
136:     if (Period.between(dob, LocalDate.now()).years < 13) {
137:       return Triple(null, null, "Must be at least 13 years old")
138:     }
139:   } catch (_: DateTimeException) {
140:     return Triple("Invalid day", "Invalid month", "Invalid year")
141:   }
142:   return Triple(null, null, null)
143: }
